numinance.kinds.v1.KnowledgeBudgets.json.description: KnowledgeBudgets bounds the calls of one connection; an explicit 0 is refused.

bytes_per_call.description: bytes_per_call is the most bytes one fetch returns.

calls_per_stage.description: calls_per_stage is the most searches and fetches in one stage.

numinance.kinds.v1.KnowledgeBudgets.json.title: Knowledge Budgets

numinance.kinds.v1.KnowledgeConnectionSp.description:
KnowledgeConnectionSpec says which provider reaches the source, under whose authority, and within what bounds. The
 field names are fixed by this schema; renaming one is for the spec maintainers.

budgets.description: budgets bounds the calls of one connection; it only lowers the stage budgets, never raises them.

cache_ttl.description: cache_ttl is how long a fetched document is cached; absent means 30 days and 0s disables the cache.

endpoint.description:
endpoint is the https URL of the source; absent for a provider that reads the worktree. The loader refuses one that is
 not "https://" with a lower-case DNS host of two or more labels (no IP literal, numeric or single-label host, trailing
 dot, or .localhost, .local or .internal suffix), a port outside 1 to 65535, a "." or ".." path segment, user
 information, a query, a fragment, ";", "%", "\", a non-printable or non-ASCII byte, or over 2048 bytes; the full rule
 is the loader-checks row of sdk/go/kindyaml/README.md. Its host must also be in the provider manifest's egress
 allow-list.

oauth.description:
oauth names the OAuth client the bridge presents to the source (the per-server config of the MCP bridge: URL, OAuth client). Absent means no static client. It holds no secret: the broker holds
 every secret and issues a handle. Only the org sets it, since it decides under which client a run reads.

pinned_tools.description:
pinned_tools is the requested read-only tool subset, unique by name; an empty list allows no tool. The bridge trusts
 only the admin-approved pins of the lockfile (knowledge_tools), never these alone; drift quarantines the connection.

provider.description: provider is required: the extension id of a knowledge port provider, which must resolve to a lockfile entry.

read_only.description: read_only is required and must be true; the loader refuses false.

scope.description:
scope is required, non-empty and unique: the spaces, projects or relative paths the connection may read ("*", ".",
 "..", a leading "/" and query or glob characters are refused). A provider passes it as a parameter, never as query text.

numinance.kinds.v1.KnowledgeConnectionSp.title: Knowledge Connection Spec

numinance.kinds.v1.KnowledgeOAuth.jsonsc.description: KnowledgeOAuth is the OAuth client of a connection. It never carries a secret, and no field of it may be added that does.

client_id.description:
client_id identifies the client to the source. The loader refuses an empty one, one over 2048 bytes and any byte
 outside printable ASCII (so no whitespace, control or bidi character); one that starts with a scheme ("name:") or "//", contains "://" or a colon
 before its first "/", "?" or "#", or holds a backslash or "%", is read as a URL and must be an https URL that passes the endpoint rule of the loader-checks row of
 sdk/go/kindyaml/README.md; a "." or ".." path segment is refused.

numinance.kinds.v1.KnowledgeOAuth.jsonsc.title: KnowledgeO Auth

numinance.kinds.v1.PinnedTool.jsonschema.description: PinnedTool is one tool: its name and the hash of its canonicalised description, schemas and annotations.

name.description: name is required: the tool name as the server lists it.

numinance.kinds.v1.PinnedTool.jsonschema.title: Pinned Tool

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.description: Digest is a sha256 content digest as "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters.

value.description:
value is exactly "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters. Any other
 length, case or prefix, and an empty value in a present message, is
 rejected. Absence is the unset message.

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.title: Digest
